summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Goldman Sachs Value Opportunities ETF (GVLE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF, investing in US companies considered to be undervalued. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation through fundamental stock selection. GVLE was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.

holdings.infoBox: GVLE is an equity ETF with a total of 32 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 9.18%, Amazon.com at 7.72%, Merck & Co. at 4.90%, JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 4.42%, and Eaton Corporation at 4.30%.
